description: Environment: notices under the Environmental Management and Co-ordination Act, mostly National Environment Management Authority (NEMA) invitations to comment on an Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) study report for a proposed project; also environment committees and strategic environmental assessments.

proponent.description: Company or body proposing the project.

project_description.description: One or two sentences on what will be built or done.

location.description: Where the project is, as printed (plot, area, town).

county.description: County. MUST be one of the 47 canonical names in geography.json.

anticipated_impacts.description: Impacts listed in the notice (e.g. noise, dust, waste).

mitigation_measures.description: Proposed measures listed in the notice.

where_to_inspect.description: Offices where the report can be read.

comment_deadline.description: Period for public comments, as printed (e.g. 'within thirty (30) days').
